data.name: Tailored Sandbar Experience
data.headline: Ages 6+ • 4 Hours
data.description:
Experience the ultimate Key West adventure aboard our fun sandbar boat charter!

Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and enjoy the crystal-clear waters, sandy shores, and breathtaking views of the Florida Keys. Captain Christy will guide you to some of the most beautiful, secluded sandbars where you can swim, snorkel, and relax in the serene environment.

Whether you’re looking to spend a peaceful day on the water, celebrate a special occasion, or enjoy a fun-filled day with friends and family, our boat charter offers the perfect setting.

Sit back, unwind, and let us take care of the rest while you make unforgettable memories in one of the most picturesque locations in the world.

meeting_point.address: 7001 Shrimp Rd, Key West, FL, USA

data.cancellation_notes:
At Namaste All Day, we understand that plans can change. To ensure fairness for both our guests and our team, we have established the following cancellation policy:
- **Standard Cancellation:** Cancellations made at least **24 hours** before the scheduled charter will receive a full refund.
- **No-Show Policy:** If the customer does not show up for the charter without prior notification, the full charter fee will be charged.
- **Weather-Related Cancellations:** In the event of severe weather conditions, your charter will be rescheduled or refunded in full. The safety of our guests is always our top priority.

**To Cancel or Reschedule:** Please contact us as soon as possible by phone to make arrangements.

We appreciate your understanding and look forward to providing you with a memorable experience on the water!
